title: Resource lookup resolves inherited Object.prototype keys (GET /constructor returns 200 with empty body, PUT /toString creates a resource)
property: unknown resource names give 404, never a 200 or a mutation
expected: 404 Not Found for both; db.data gains no 'toString' key
actual: GET /constructor returns 200 with an empty body (the Object function is serialized); PUT /toString returns 200 and writes an own 'toString' key into db.data
evidence: Service.#get does this.#db.data[name] without an own-property check, although Service.has() exists and uses hasOwnProperty; the final handler returns 404 whenever the lookup yields undefined, which shows unknown names are meant to be 404.
